downloadIntro.zh: Windows 版已更新至 v1.59.72，Mac 版当前为 v1.59.60。请选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: Windows is now v1.59.72; the current Mac release is v1.59.60. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 回放时整张图表会隔帧左右晃动几个像素：价格轴随最新价标签变宽变窄，K 线区跟着挪动。现在播放中价格轴只变宽、不再变窄。
highlights.en: During replay the whole chart shook sideways by a few pixels as the price axis widened and narrowed with the last-price label. The axis now only widens while playing.
